verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair question for a computer-use automation platform, so the axis applies. The pack does not document a feature for acting on many items at once. The SDK for driving computers from code is a developer building block. Running a Cua Bench taskset with one command is benchmark evaluation, not bulk operations over user items. Item management (lock, delete, approve) is described only per item.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
